title: Add Author Attribution to README.md
description: Update the README.md file to include an author attribution section, giving credit to the original creator.
details: Open the README.md file located at the root of the repository. Add a new section titled 'Author' or 'Credits' near the end of the file, or add a byline near the top, following the existing style. Include the author's name ('RafiulM') and a markdown-formatted link to their profile (e.g., https://github.com/RafiulM). Ensure the formatting is consistent with the rest of the README and that the link renders correctly in markdown previews.
test_strategy: Manually preview the updated README.md file in a markdown viewer or on the repository hosting platform (e.g., GitHub) to verify that the author section is visible, correctly formatted, and the link works. Confirm that no other parts of the README are broken by the change.
